game: Resident Evil Code: Veronica X HD (2000/2011)
target: 100% completion of the selected HD route, spoiler-free

areas.name: HD Route and Save Setup
areas.location_cue: The HD title menu, difficulty selector, emulator storage, and cleared-data slots.
areas.note: Primary route: Code: Veronica X HD on PS3 or Xbox 360; emulation is only a recording fallback.

levels.1: Confirm the release before beginning the completion file.
levels.2: Use the PlayStation 3 or Xbox 360 HD edition.
levels.3: Launch Code: Veronica X HD on original hardware, RPCS3, or Xenia. Verify that the title identifies the expanded X edition; do not substitute the Dreamcast, PlayStation 2, or GameCube release.

levels.1: Keep ordinary saves separate from emulator recovery tools.
levels.2: Create dated backups outside RPCS3 or Xenia.
levels.3: Close the emulator before copying its user-data folder. Keep labelled backups for the prison departure, first Antarctic handoff, midpoint offer, late handoff, final controls, campaign A-rank attempt, and completed Battle roster.

levels.1: Use the standard rule set for the primary ledger.
levels.2: Begin the main completion file on Normal.
levels.3: Start a fresh Normal file and use it for the complete campaign, optional weapon chain, every document except the Battle-only diary, and the A-rank reward. Never overwrite its cleared data with an unrelated run.

levels.1: Follow every physical region through its final control room.
levels.2: Finish one complete Code: Veronica X HD campaign.
levels.3: Clear the prison, palace, airport, training complex, and Antarctic facilities, then finish the final mechanical sequence. Save the result when prompted; this creates Battle Game access without exposing the ending in the checklist.

levels.1: The bonus mode gains another camera after a campaign clear.
levels.2: Finish the campaign, then open Battle Game's view selector.
levels.3: After saving cleared campaign data, enter Battle Game and confirm both third-person and first-person views can be selected. Complete at least one full character route with each camera setting.

save_backup.title: Back up before starting
save_backup.why: Campaign, rank, and Battle flags should remain on one protected data set.

areas.name: Prison and Detector Route
areas.location_cue: Holding cells, a graveyard, barracks, the guillotine yard, and a two-sided metal scanner.
areas.note: SAVE-BACKUP: local security boxes do not connect to later Item Boxes.

levels.1: One optional legacy trick depends on the starting document.
levels.2: Do not open the Playing Manual until deciding about the healing secret.
levels.3: Leave the Playing Manual unread in Claire's starting inventory. If you want a conventional file, read it normally; if you want to document the infinite-healing secret, preserve a separate backup before ever opening it.

levels.1: The scanner rejects weapons and other metallic equipment.
levels.2: Deposit every metal item before walking through the detector corridor.
levels.3: Use the security box beside the scanner for all metal equipment, cross unarmed, and use the box at the far end for supplies needed on that side. These are local security boxes, not the shared Item Box.

levels.1: A vehicle fire hides an examinable case.
levels.2: Take the extinguisher from the guillotine garage and use it in the graveyard.
levels.3: Raise the guillotine-area shutter, collect the Fire Extinguisher from the garage, return to the burning truck in the graveyard, and use it once. Keep track of the resulting Empty Extinguisher; it has a later optional use.

levels.1: Rotate containers before assuming they are empty.
levels.2: Inspect the graveyard briefcase around its handle edge.
levels.3: After extinguishing the truck fire, take the briefcase. In Check view rotate it to the narrow face by the handle, press the concealed catch, and remove the TG-01 material.

levels.1: The machine needs a scanned pattern and a compatible material.
levels.2: Scan the Eagle Plate, then load TG-01 into the fabricator.
levels.3: Place the Eagle Plate on the scanning side before surrendering it, carry TG-01 back through the detector route, and insert the material into the opposite unit. Take the non-metal duplicate after fabrication completes.

levels.1: An early request can still be answered before leaving the island.
levels.2: Bring the medicine back to the Holding Cells before using the exit route.
levels.3: Collect the Hemostatic Medicine from the palace save room and backtrack to the original Holding Cells. Hand it over before leaving the island; this satisfies one campaign A-rank condition and exchanges it for the Lighter.

levels.1: The returned medicine starts a useful tool chain.
levels.2: After delivering the medicine, exchange the Lighter for the Lockpick.
levels.3: Complete the medicine return, accept the Lighter, and continue the nearby exchange to receive the Lockpick. Revisit previously seen simple locks before the island departure; the Lighter becomes recoverable later by the next playable inventory.

levels.1: A wall charge accepts a small flame before the island is left.
levels.2: Use the Lighter on the guillotine-room detonator.
levels.3: While Claire still carries the Lighter, ignite the detonator attached to the locked cabinet near the guillotine. Much later, return after the barrier can be opened and collect all ammunition revealed by the blast.

levels.1: Anything left beside the detector does not join shared storage.
levels.2: Recover every item from both ends of the metal-detector corridor.
levels.3: Before inserting the alloy emblem at the prison exit, cross the detector one final time and empty both local boxes. Carry the Empty Extinguisher to a normal Item Box; abandoned objects cannot be recovered after departure.

levels.1: The next route closes the detector, cells, and graveyard.
levels.2: Make a permanent save before opening the outer prison gate.
levels.3: After finishing the medicine, Lockpick, detonator, files, map, and security-box cleanup, save in a separate slot. Do not cross the bridge toward the palace until the Empty Extinguisher is inside the shared Item Box.

save_backup.title: Preserve a pre-departure save
save_backup.why: Medicine, Lockpick rooms, the detonator, and stored equipment can all be lost here.

point_of_no_return.title: The outer prison gate closes this region
point_of_no_return.why: Empty both detector boxes and finish every backtrack before crossing the bridge.

areas.name: Palace, Residence, and Airport
areas.location_cue: A formal hall, private bedrooms, an upper study, submarine dock, and cargo platforms.
areas.note: Puzzle answers expose only physical interactions and codes.

levels.1: A nearby document supplies the terminal's alphanumeric entry.
levels.2: Enter NTC0394 at the palace computer.
levels.3: Read the code clue, activate the office terminal, and enter NTC0394 without spaces. Take the newly accessible key item and check the surrounding drawers before leaving the office.

levels.1: A display case conceals both a route and an alarm.
levels.2: Take the paired pistols from the concealed palace display.
levels.3: Open the hidden wall section, take the Gold Lugers, and immediately respond to the heat-trap sequence by reaching the adjacent control. Recover the pistols afterward and use them in the matching office door recess.

levels.1: The campaign rank judges one timed room response.
levels.2: Resolve the Gold Luger heat trap immediately.
levels.3: For the A-rank file, skip inventory sorting and optional pickups when the alarm begins. Sprint directly to the release control and complete the rescue sequence as soon as control returns; delay can invalidate the rank.

levels.1: Turn directions reveal four digits rather than a melody.
levels.2: Use left-right, left, right, then three rights to obtain 1971.
levels.3: At the office music box, reset once, then perform the four groups without another reset: left-right; left; right; right-right-right. Enter the resulting 1971 at the desk computer and use the opened passage.

levels.1: The family memo arranges the paintings by succession.
levels.2: Press Veronica, Stanley, Thomas, Arthur, Edward, Alexander, then Alfred.
levels.3: Use the visual subjects in this order: purple-dressed woman with cup; blond man with twins; young red-haired man with cup; old red-haired man with vase; gray-haired reader with vase; blond candle-holder; blond child. Reset at the child's portrait if a press is wrong.

levels.1: The portrait reward contains more than decoration.
levels.2: Take the revealed vase and inspect its interior.
levels.3: After solving all seven portraits, collect the Earthenware Vase below the newly exposed painting. Rotate it in Check view, look down into the opening, and remove the Queen Ant Object.

levels.1: A silent instrument opens a display elsewhere in the room.
levels.2: Insert the Piano Roll into the game-room piano.
levels.3: Retrieve the Piano Roll from its locked location with the Lockpick, carry it to the palace game room, and use it on the piano. When the performance ends, take the newly revealed King Ant Object.

levels.1: Two matching devices share a removable music plate.
levels.2: Use each Ant Object, then move the plate between the music boxes.
levels.3: Open the red device with the Queen Ant Object and stop it before removing its Music Box Plate. Open the blue device with the King Ant Object, insert that plate, and climb the ladder exposed by the lowered bed.

levels.1: The wall slot accepts only the insect's body.
levels.2: Remove the Silver Dragonfly's wings before using it in the ant picture.
levels.3: Take the Silver Dragonfly from the carousel room, examine it, and detach both wings. Insert the wingless body into the wall ant; the carousel rotates and completes the ladder to the upper study.

levels.1: The rotated carousel leads to documents and one proof.
levels.2: Use the movable box to reach the study's high shelf.
levels.3: Climb to the upper study, move the floor box beneath the glass-case shelving, then collect the Confession Letter and Air Force Proof from above. Inspect the nearby surface for the Newspaper Clip before descending.

levels.1: The lift accepts a compact rectangle of freight.
levels.2: Push the two loose crates into the empty corners of the platform.
levels.3: From the control level, move each crate until the four containers form one flush block inside the marked lift footprint. Leave no crate projecting over the edge, then activate the cargo control.

items.label: Army, Navy, and Air Force Proofs

levels.1: Three military emblems belong in one transport console.
levels.2: Place all three Proofs into the airport panel.
levels.3: Collect the Army, Navy, and Air Force Proofs across the island, preserve them in the Item Box, and insert the complete trio at the airport control. Do not begin the departure sequence until island cleanup is complete.

save_backup.title: Save before committing the three Proofs
save_backup.why: The transport sequence closes all remaining island cleanup.

point_of_no_return.title: Airport departure commits the first island route
point_of_no_return.why: Finish palace files, study shelves, maps, Side Pack, and optional rooms first.

areas.name: Training Facility
areas.location_cue: Observation rooms, a garage, gallery, basement, hangar, and map-printing office.
areas.note: Several weapons and one bonus-roster flag depend on objects found here.

levels.1: A blue office terminal controls a nearby printer.
levels.2: Activate the map terminal, then take the printout beside it.
levels.3: In the facility control office, use the blue-screen terminal and confirm the print command. Move to the connected printer, collect the Training Facility Map, and open it once to register all visible floors.

levels.1: An observation room pairs a document with a ranged weapon.
levels.2: Take the Bow Gun from the table near the small cages.
levels.3: Enter the Training Facility Observation Room, inspect the table beside the cages, and take both the Bow Gun and Pass Number Memo. Equip the weapon once and preserve its powder for explosive arrows.

levels.1: A secured storage route holds the campaign's multi-ammunition launcher.
levels.2: Open the training storage room and take the Grenade Launcher.
levels.3: Use the facility access items to enter the locked storage room, clear enough inventory for two slots, and collect the Grenade Launcher. Load each round family separately rather than combining incompatible ammunition.

levels.1: A gallery model conceals a matching recess.
levels.2: Place the Miniature Tank in the training-facility diorama.
levels.3: Bring the Miniature Tank to the Gallery and fit it into the incomplete display. Take the Passage Memo and Turn Table Key from the opened recess before leaving the room.

levels.1: One handgun accepts a model-specific attachment.
levels.2: Collect the M93R Part and combine it with Claire's handgun.
levels.3: Find the M93R Part in the training-facility route, keep Claire's original M93R rather than discarding it, and combine the two in inventory. Equip the upgraded pistol and test its selectable burst behavior.

levels.1: A required basement sequence introduces a paired automatic weapon.
levels.2: Take control of the M-100P during the training basement route.
levels.3: During the basement traversal, collect and fire the paired M-100P pistols when they become available. Later confirm their remaining ammunition state; they count as a distinct weapon even though the route temporarily controls who carries them.

levels.1: Equipment carried past the transport sequence may become unavailable for hours.
levels.2: Store the strongest shared weapons before the first Antarctic transition.
levels.3: Before committing all three Proofs and leaving the airport, place the Grenade Launcher, excess ammunition, healing, the Empty Extinguisher, and any optional tools in the shared Item Box. Carry only what the departing inventory needs immediately.

save_backup.title: Back up before the Antarctic transfer
save_backup.why: Shared-box planning controls which weapons remain available.

areas.name: First Antarctic Visit
areas.location_cue: Foggy bunk rooms, industrial platforms, a machining room, weapons storage, and an exterior deck.
areas.note: SAVE-BACKUP: collect the rifle and store equipment before the inventory changes.

levels.1: Fog makes a wall sheet in the sleeping quarters easy to miss.
levels.2: Take the map mounted between the beds in the bunk room.
levels.3: Enter the Antarctic sleeping quarters, face the wall between the beds, and examine the faintly visible sheet. Open the acquired map and confirm the base floors are registered before leaving this section.

levels.1: A weapon cabinet can be opened during the first base visit.
levels.2: Take the assault rifle from the Antarctic weapons area.
levels.3: Reach the weapons storage route while its controls are available, open the cabinet, and collect the AK-47. Equip it once, note its percentage ammunition, and store it before the next inventory handoff unless immediately needed.

levels.1: The existing handle does not match every socket.
levels.2: Use the machining device to convert the Valve Handle to an octagonal fitting.
levels.3: Carry the Valve Handle into the modification room, place it in the cutting machine, and operate the control until its end becomes octagonal. Retrieve it before leaving; later water controls require this altered form.

levels.1: An outdoor transition briefly places a long-range weapon within reach.
levels.2: Collect the Sniper Rifle on the exterior platform before proceeding.
levels.3: On the Antarctic exterior platform, pick up the dropped Sniper Rifle as soon as free movement returns. Check that it occupies two slots and use its scope during the encounter; passing the transition without taking it forfeits this campaign copy.

items.label: Use Only the Offered Midpoint Save

levels.1: One automatic prompt is exempt from the A-rank save restriction.
levels.2: Accept the dedicated midpoint save and avoid every typewriter.
levels.3: For an A-rank run, never record at a typewriter. Accept the single save prompt offered between the campaign's two large sections; it does not count against the final grade and is the only safe recovery point for that attempt.

items.label: Store Gear Before the Control Change

levels.1: The next inventory begins elsewhere and shares only Item Box contents.
levels.2: Deposit the rifle alternatives, launcher, ammunition, and healing before the transition.
levels.3: Before completing the exterior sequence, use the last accessible Item Box to leave the Grenade Launcher, AK-47 if retained, explosive arrows, spare healing, and the Empty Extinguisher for the following inventory. Keep only the equipment needed for the immediate encounter.

save_backup.title: Keep the offered midpoint save
save_backup.why: It is the only campaign save exempt from A-rank penalties.

point_of_no_return.title: The exterior transition ends this inventory phase
point_of_no_return.why: Take the map and rifle, then stage shared equipment before proceeding.

areas.name: Return Route and Optional Weapons
areas.location_cue: Reopened island rooms, a training workbench, basement lifts, and later Antarctic machinery.
areas.note: The Lighter, Empty Extinguisher, and colored drawers gate three optional weapons or modes.

levels.1: The returning inventory begins with a different handgun family.
levels.2: Use the Glock 17 from Chris's initial equipment.
levels.3: When the second main inventory begins, inspect the Glock 17, equip it, and fire it once. Do not confuse its upgrade path with Claire's M93R part; the Glock is improved at a physical machine.

levels.1: A workbench improves the second handgun without a loose attachment.
levels.2: Place the Glock 17 into the training-facility modification machine.
levels.3: Return to the appropriate facility workroom, use the bench control with the Glock 17 in inventory, and retrieve the Modified Glock. Test it against an ordinary target to register the distinct upgraded weapon.

levels.1: The earlier medicine exchange makes a small tool available again.
levels.2: Complete the creature rescue near the prison return and receive the Lighter.
levels.3: If Claire delivered the Hemostatic Medicine, finish the optional rescue during the return to the prison side and accept the Lighter. If the medicine was skipped, this exchange and its concealed weapon cache are unavailable on that file.

levels.1: A small flame opens a compartment near the returning inventory's starting room.
levels.2: Use the recovered Lighter on the wall torch beside the statue.
levels.3: After receiving the Lighter, backtrack to the first room used by this inventory. Ignite the small wall torch beside the statue; take both Ingram submachine guns from the opened compartment and equip them together.

levels.1: A hanging weapon also acts as an elevator counterweight.
levels.2: Take the shotgun from its basement rack and replace it when changing floors.
levels.3: Remove the SPAS-12 from the suspended rack to lower the connected stairs or lift. Whenever the route needs the platform in its other position, return the shotgun temporarily; retrieve it permanently after the last required elevation change.

levels.1: A colored drawer sequence grants a bonus-roster flag.
levels.2: Open the red, green, blue, then brown drawers in the hangar save room.
levels.3: At the cabinet in the Training Facility hangar save room, open red, green, and blue in that order. The brown bottom drawer then releases; take the Gold Luger Replica and place it in the shared Item Box to unlock Steve in Battle Game.

levels.1: Each removable jewel hides a different supply.
levels.2: Swap the blue and red jewels one at a time in the tiger statue.
levels.3: Remove the blue eye and collect the Socket, then replace it. Remove the red eye for Magnum ammunition and restore it afterward. Once power is disabled later, take both jewels permanently for their matching door uses.

levels.1: The object itself displays the four-button answer.
levels.2: Press AA, crown, heart, then spade at the storage capsule.
levels.3: Examine the Paperweight and rotate it to read its markings. At the capsule console press AA, crown, heart, and spade in that order; when the drawer opens, insert the Paperweight to raise the stored container.

levels.1: The old cylinder fits an Antarctic service tank.
levels.2: Take the Empty Extinguisher from the Item Box and use the refill unit.
levels.3: Bring the Empty Extinguisher saved from the prison into the Antarctic water-tank room. Raise the refill cylinder with the nearby control, use the empty tool on it, and keep the refilled extinguisher for the lower fire barrier.

levels.1: A second fire blocks the campaign's Magnum.
levels.2: Use the refilled extinguisher below the water-tank room.
levels.3: Ride the rear lift to the weapons chamber, extinguish the flames with the refilled cylinder, and take the Colt Python. If the Empty Extinguisher was abandoned in a prison security box, this weapon cannot be recovered on the current run.

save_backup.title: Back up before using old one-use tools
save_backup.why: Missed earlier exchanges cannot be repaired on the current campaign.

areas.name: Final Physical Controls
areas.location_cue: Frozen laboratories, paired music rooms, a storage capsule, crushing machinery, and a security console.
areas.note: SAVE-BACKUP: finish all collection and inventory transfers before the last command.

levels.1: The modified handle needs one added connector.
levels.2: Combine the Socket with the octagonal Valve Handle, then use it at the tank.
levels.3: Fit the Socket onto the converted octagonal Valve Handle, insert the assembly into the raised tank control, and operate it. Climb into the drained space, take the Crane Key, and be ready for an immediate attack while exiting.

levels.1: The paired bedroom devices repeat an earlier plate transfer.
levels.2: Stop the red music box, move its plate, and start the blue one.
levels.3: Use the matching jewels to open both devices. Stop the red music box before removing its plate, insert that plate into the blue box, and climb the ladder exposed when the bed lowers.

levels.1: One body and four separate wings form the door key.
levels.2: Combine the Dragonfly Object with all four Wing Objects.
levels.3: Take the Dragonfly Object from the upper room, collect three wings along the surrounding route, and release the fourth from its glass case with the lower control. Combine all four wings with the body before approaching the insect-shaped lock.

levels.1: The moving slab can break both the sphere and the player.
levels.2: Place the Crystal Ball beneath the crusher only after baiting one drop.
levels.3: Lower the cannon to obtain the Crystal Ball. Trigger the ceiling crusher from a safe edge, wait for it to retract, step under it, place the ball at the marked center through inventory, and retreat immediately. Return after impact for the Security Card.

levels.1: The short side route can strand weapons needed by the final inventory.
levels.2: Leave the Magnum, launcher, and strongest ammunition in the Item Box.
levels.3: Before opening the route that begins the late alternate-control section, deposit the Colt Python, Grenade Launcher, Ingrams, shotgun ammunition, and at least two full heals. Carry only enough protection for the short required passage.

levels.1: The final terminal accepts one word printed by nearby clues.
levels.2: Use the Security Card and enter VERONICA.
levels.3: Bring the completed Gold Dragonfly through its lock, climb to the security console, insert the Security Card, and type VERONICA. Do not confirm the final system command until files, weapons, and handoffs are complete.

levels.1: The last command ends all physical cleanup.
levels.2: Save in a separate slot before entering the security password.
levels.3: Finish the 24-file archive, take both Side Packs, retrieve every optional weapon, and place final combat supplies in the Item Box. Make a permanent backup before using the Security Card and final terminal.

levels.1: There is one campaign outcome to record on this edition.
levels.2: Complete the final mechanical sequence and save the clear data.
levels.3: After the security command, finish the remaining combat and timed escape mechanics, then allow the result screen to finish. Save the completion data in its own slot; the guide deliberately withholds every narrative event and final scene.

save_backup.title: Keep a final control-room save
save_backup.why: It preserves cleanup, equipment, and the late handoff.

point_of_no_return.title: The security command ends free cleanup
point_of_no_return.why: Collect files, weapons, both Side Packs, and final supplies before confirming it.

areas.name: Complete File Archive
areas.location_cue: Document surfaces across every campaign region and one optional Battle Game room.
areas.note: Read all 24 files; the final diary is a random bonus-mode reward.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Playing Manual from the starting inventory.
levels.3: Reach the starting inventory while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Playing Manual through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 1 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Facility Entrance Fax from the security office controls.
levels.3: Reach the security office controls while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Facility Entrance Fax through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 2 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect TG-01 Product Description from the graveyard briefcase.
levels.3: Reach the graveyard briefcase while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open TG-01 Product Description through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 3 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect User's Manual from the security hallway table.
levels.3: Reach the security hallway table while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open User's Manual through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 4 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Pass Number Memo from the observation room table.
levels.3: Reach the observation room table while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Pass Number Memo through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 5 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Memo to New Master from the masters room portrait.
levels.3: Reach the masters room portrait while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Memo to New Master through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 6 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Security File from the floor below cannon.
levels.3: Reach the floor below cannon while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Security File through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 7 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Alloy Report from the garage pedestal.
levels.3: Reach the garage pedestal while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Alloy Report through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 8 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Prisoner's Diary from the barracks middle upper bed.
levels.3: Reach the barracks middle upper bed while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Prisoner's Diary through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 9 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Anatomist's Note from the autopsy side-room table.
levels.3: Reach the autopsy side-room table while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Anatomist's Note through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 10 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Secretary's Note from the palace save-room table.
levels.3: Reach the palace save-room table while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Secretary's Note through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 11 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: One document exists only inside the bonus mode's optional room.
levels.2: In Battle Game, use the lit slot machine in the side Game Room.
levels.3: Before the route's later combat rooms, take the side door into the Game Room and inspect the illuminated slot machine. Its reward is random; restart the character route until D.I.J.'s Diary appears, then open it fully.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Newspaper Clip from the study upper platform.
levels.3: Reach the study upper platform while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Newspaper Clip through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 13 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Message Card from the private bedroom desk.
levels.3: Reach the private bedroom desk while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Message Card through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 14 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Hunk's Report from the conference-room rear table.
levels.3: Reach the conference-room rear table while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Hunk's Report through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 15 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Worker's Diary from the Antarctic bunks table.
levels.3: Reach the Antarctic bunks table while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Worker's Diary through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 16 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Alexander's Memo from the Antarctic office desk.
levels.3: Reach the Antarctic office desk while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Alexander's Memo through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 17 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Butler's Letter from the hidden office locker.
levels.3: Reach the hidden office locker while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Butler's Letter through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 18 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Confession Letter from the study glass-case shelf.
levels.3: Reach the study glass-case shelf while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Confession Letter through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 19 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Passage Memo from the gallery model recess.
levels.3: Reach the gallery model recess while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Passage Memo through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 20 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Veronica Report from the laboratory control-room chair.
levels.3: Reach the laboratory control-room chair while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Veronica Report through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 21 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Alfred's Diary from the Halberd cabinet.
levels.3: Reach the Halberd cabinet while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Alfred's Diary through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 22 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Queen Ant Report from the laboratory study desk.
levels.3: Reach the laboratory study desk while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Queen Ant Report through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 23 before crossing the next area transition.

levels.1: Check desks, beds, shelves, and control surfaces before leaving each room.
levels.2: Collect Virus Research Report from the incubation-room control surface.
levels.3: Reach the incubation-room control surface while that room remains accessible, inspect the document prompt, and open Virus Research Report through its final page. Confirm it occupies archive slot 24 before crossing the next area transition.

save_backup.title: Back up before every region exit
save_backup.why: Most documents become unreachable after transport or character transitions.

areas.name: Maps and Inventory Upgrades
areas.location_cue: Four mounted or printed maps and two character-specific Side Packs.
areas.note: Each Side Pack permanently expands only the inventory that collects it.

levels.1: Inspect mounted plans and working office equipment in each major region.
levels.2: Collect Prison Map at the barracks mess-hall wall.
levels.3: Reach the barracks mess-hall wall, face the mounted plan, and use the examine prompt to collect Prison Map. Open it from the map screen once so every currently visible floor registers.

levels.1: Inspect mounted plans and working office equipment in each major region.
levels.2: Collect Palace Map at the submarine-dock wall alcove.
levels.3: Reach the submarine-dock wall alcove, face the mounted plan, and use the examine prompt to collect Palace Map. Open it from the map screen once so every currently visible floor registers.

levels.1: Inspect mounted plans and working office equipment in each major region.
levels.2: Collect Training Facility Map at the blue terminal printer.
levels.3: Use the blue office computer to send the facility plan to its printer, then collect the sheet from the adjacent output tray. Open it once and check every displayed floor.

levels.1: Inspect mounted plans and working office equipment in each major region.
levels.2: Collect Antarctic Base Map at the bunks wall between beds.
levels.3: Reach the bunks wall between beds, face the mounted plan, and use the examine prompt to collect Antarctic Base Map. Open it from the map screen once so every currently visible floor registers.

levels.1: A small pouch permanently adds two inventory spaces.
levels.2: Collect the Side Pack in the palace submarine dock.
levels.3: Search the palace submarine dock before its route closes, take the Side Pack, and confirm the active inventory expands by two slots immediately. Each of the two main inventories has its own pack; collect both on the same campaign file.

levels.1: A small pouch permanently adds two inventory spaces.
levels.2: Collect the Side Pack in the Antarctic laboratory storage area.
levels.3: Search the Antarctic laboratory storage area before its route closes, take the Side Pack, and confirm the active inventory expands by two slots immediately. Each of the two main inventories has its own pack; collect both on the same campaign file.

save_backup.title: Check upgrades before each handoff
save_backup.why: A missed Side Pack cannot be transferred through the Item Box.

areas.name: Weapons and Ammunition
areas.location_cue: Starting inventories, fixed rooms, optional caches, upgrades, and completion rewards.
areas.note: Obtain, equip, and test every campaign and Battle-only weapon or ammunition family.

levels.1: Handle every fixed, optional, upgraded, and reward weapon at least once.
levels.2: Obtain Combat Knife from the starting equipment.
levels.3: Inspect the Combat Knife in the first inventory, equip it, and land one downward slash. Repeat with the later inventory if its separate starting knife appears; Battle Game also uses this weapon.

levels.1: Handle every fixed, optional, upgraded, and reward weapon at least once.
levels.2: Obtain M93R Handgun from the Claire starting equipment.
levels.3: Keep Claire's starting M93R, equip it, and fire one standard shot. Do not discard it before finding its dedicated part because the attachment creates a separately recordable burst-fire version.

levels.1: Handle every fixed, optional, upgraded, and reward weapon at least once.
levels.2: Obtain M93R Burst from the combine handgun upgrade.
levels.3: Combine the M93R Part with Claire's original M93R in the inventory menu. Equip the resulting M93R Burst, switch or test its firing behavior, and retain it through the next shared-box handoff.

levels.1: Handle every fixed, optional, upgraded, and reward weapon at least once.
levels.2: Obtain Glock 17 from the Chris starting equipment.
levels.3: Equip the Glock 17 when the later main inventory begins and fire it once. Preserve it until the training-facility workbench can modify it; the M93R attachment cannot be used on this handgun.

levels.1: Handle every fixed, optional, upgraded, and reward weapon at least once.
levels.2: Obtain Modified Glock 17 from the modify at workbench.
levels.3: Insert the Glock 17 into the facility workbench's modification device and operate the machine. Retrieve the Modified Glock 17, equip it, and verify its improved performance on an ordinary target.

levels.1: Handle every fixed, optional, upgraded, and reward weapon at least once.
levels.2: Obtain M-100P from the training basement sequence.
levels.3: Use the M-100P during the required training-facility basement sequence, then check its percentage ammunition when the paired pistols change hands. Firing them at least once records this distinct automatic weapon.

levels.1: Handle every fixed, optional, upgraded, and reward weapon at least once.
levels.2: Obtain Bow Gun from the observation-room table.
levels.3: Take the Bow Gun from the observation-room table near the cages. Equip it with ordinary arrows, then create and fire at least one explosive arrow batch by combining Bow Gun Powder with arrows.

levels.1: Handle every fixed, optional, upgraded, and reward weapon at least once.
levels.2: Obtain Grenade Launcher from the training storage room.
levels.3: Open the secured training storage room, clear two inventory spaces, and take the Grenade Launcher. Equip and fire grenade, acid, and flame ammunition on separate safe targets.

levels.1: Handle every fixed, optional, upgraded, and reward weapon at least once.
levels.2: Obtain AK-47 Assault Rifle from the Antarctic weapons cabinet.
levels.3: Open the Antarctic weapons cabinet during the first visit, take the AK-47, and equip it. Fire a short burst while watching its percentage counter, then store it before the inventory transition.

levels.1: Handle every fixed, optional, upgraded, and reward weapon at least once.
levels.2: Obtain Sniper Rifle from the Antarctic outdoor platform.
levels.3: Pick up the Sniper Rifle from the exterior Antarctic platform before the encounter begins. Enter its scope, fire it during that sequence, and do not leave the platform without collecting it first.

levels.1: Handle every fixed, optional, upgraded, and reward weapon at least once.
levels.2: Obtain SPAS-12 Shotgun from the hanging basement rack.
levels.3: Remove the SPAS-12 from its hanging basement bracket and equip it once. Use it as the route's counterweight whenever required, then retrieve it permanently after the final platform adjustment.

levels.1: Handle every fixed, optional, upgraded, and reward weapon at least once.
levels.2: Obtain Colt Python from the Antarctic fire chamber.
levels.3: Carry the saved Empty Extinguisher to Antarctica, refill it, and use it on the lower weapons-room blaze. Take the Colt Python beyond the extinguished barrier, load Magnum ammunition, and fire one shot.

levels.1: Handle every fixed, optional, upgraded, and reward weapon at least once.
levels.2: Obtain Gold Lugers from the palace display case.
levels.3: Take the Gold Lugers from the hidden palace display, survive the alarm release, and recover them. Equip the pair once before fitting them into the office-door recess as a route key.

levels.1: Handle every fixed, optional, upgraded, and reward weapon at least once.
levels.2: Obtain Ingram Submachine Guns from the lighter statue compartment.
levels.3: Return the Hemostatic Medicine, later recover the Lighter, and ignite the small statue-room torch. Collect both Ingrams from the opened compartment and equip them as a paired weapon.

levels.1: Handle every fixed, optional, upgraded, and reward weapon at least once.
levels.2: Obtain Infinite Rocket Launcher from the campaign A-rank reward.
levels.3: Finish the campaign with A rank, save the result, then start or load the rewarded campaign data. Open the first shared Item Box, take the Infinite Rocket Launcher, equip it, and fire it on a disposable branch.

levels.1: Handle every fixed, optional, upgraded, and reward weapon at least once.
levels.2: Obtain Linear Launcher from the five Battle A-ranks.
levels.3: Earn A with Claire, Alternate Claire, Chris, Steve, and Wesker in Battle Game. Start another Battle route, confirm the infinite Linear Launcher is in the opening inventory, and fire it; runs using it do not receive a normal grade.

levels.1: Use each ammunition family in its compatible weapon.
levels.2: Obtain and fire Bow Gun Arrows; it is standard bow ammunition.
levels.3: Load ordinary Bow Gun Arrows into the Bow Gun and fire one unmodified projectile. Keep a separate stack before combining powder so both ammunition forms are documented.

levels.1: Use each ammunition family in its compatible weapon.
levels.2: Obtain and fire Gun Powder Arrows; it is combine powder and arrows.
levels.3: Combine Bow Gun Powder with a stack of arrows to create Gun Powder Arrows. Load the converted stack, fire one explosive projectile from a safe distance, and preserve the remainder for strong encounters.

levels.1: Use each ammunition family in its compatible weapon.
levels.2: Obtain and fire Grenade Rounds; it is launcher standard rounds.
levels.3: Load standard Grenade Rounds into the Grenade Launcher and discharge one shell. Unload or empty the current cylinder before switching ammunition families; the menu does not merge unlike launcher rounds.

levels.1: Use each ammunition family in its compatible weapon.
levels.2: Obtain and fire Acid Rounds; it is launcher acid rounds.
levels.3: Select Acid Rounds when the Grenade Launcher can accept a new load, equip the launcher, and fire one acid shell. Store remaining rounds for targets where their damage type is useful.

levels.1: Use each ammunition family in its compatible weapon.
levels.2: Obtain and fire Flame Rounds; it is launcher flame rounds.
levels.3: Load Flame Rounds into the empty Grenade Launcher and fire one shell where splash damage cannot trap the player. Confirm the ammunition name changes before marking it handled.

levels.1: Use each ammunition family in its compatible weapon.
levels.2: Obtain and fire B.O.W. Gas Rounds; it is special launcher canisters.
levels.3: During Alternate Claire's Battle route, load and fire a B.O.W. Gas Round from the Grenade Launcher. The slot machine can also award an infinite supply for that route, but it is not guaranteed.

levels.1: Use each ammunition family in its compatible weapon.
levels.2: Obtain and fire Shotgun Shells; it is shotgun ammunition.
levels.3: Load Shotgun Shells into the SPAS-12 and fire once at close but safe range. Retrieve the shotgun after its final use as a counterweight so the ammunition remains usable.

levels.1: Use each ammunition family in its compatible weapon.
levels.2: Obtain and fire Assault Rifle Bullets; it is rifle percentage ammunition.
levels.3: Equip the AK-47 or Alternate Claire's Battle rifle and fire until the percentage display decreases. Record campaign and unlimited Battle behavior separately.

levels.1: Use each ammunition family in its compatible weapon.
levels.2: Obtain and fire Magnum Bullets; it is magnum ammunition.
levels.3: Load Magnum Bullets into the Colt Python and fire one campaign shot. In Wesker's Battle route, the optional slot-machine Magnum has only six rounds and should be reserved for the final room.

save_backup.title: Back up before consuming rare ammunition
save_backup.why: One test shot should not compromise the final campaign loadout.

areas.name: Campaign Rank and Unlocks
areas.location_cue: The result screen, midpoint save prompt, Item Boxes, and Battle Game menu.
areas.note: A rank is a separate clean run with strict time, save, retry, healing, and rescue rules.

levels.1: A fast, clean run unlocks the campaign's strongest reward.
levels.2: Finish in under 4:30 with every A-rank restriction satisfied.
levels.3: Clear Normal in less than four hours thirty minutes, use no typewriter, accept only the exempt midpoint save, never choose Retry, never use First Aid Spray, deliver the Hemostatic Medicine, and resolve the Gold-Luger trap immediately.

levels.1: Inventory planning and direct routing protect the only time threshold.
levels.2: Reach the result screen before 4:30:00.
levels.3: Pause only through a method confirmed not to advance the timer on your chosen hardware, keep puzzle items staged in shared boxes, and avoid optional backtracking during the rank file. Finish at 4:29:59 or faster.

levels.1: The offered midpoint record is treated differently from manual saving.
levels.2: Use zero typewriters; accept only the midpoint prompt.
levels.3: Do not spend any Ink Ribbon or activate a typewriter during the A-rank file. Use the campaign's dedicated midpoint save when offered; emulator state backups are recovery tools and should not replace legitimate completion evidence.

levels.1: Continuing after a failed encounter invalidates the top result.
levels.2: Reload a prior legitimate save instead of selecting Retry.
levels.3: If the game offers Retry or Continue after failure, return to the title menu and reload the exempt midpoint save or restart the attempt. Never confirm the retry option on the successful A-rank run.

levels.1: Herbs heal safely; aerosol healing changes the grade.
levels.2: Use herbs only and never activate a First Aid Spray.
levels.3: Store or ignore every First Aid Spray during the rank attempt. Green herbs and mixed herb combinations are permitted, including red and blue mixtures; verify the healing item name before using it.

levels.1: One early return trip is mandatory despite the time target.
levels.2: Return the medicine to the Holding Cells before departing the island.
levels.3: Collect the Hemostatic Medicine from the palace save room, route directly back to the original cell, and hand it over. Complete the Lighter exchange while there, then resume the fastest prison-exit route.

levels.1: A delayed palace response can erase an otherwise perfect result.
levels.2: Sprint to the release control as soon as the Gold-Luger alarm begins.
levels.3: Prepare inventory before taking the Gold Lugers. When the alarm locks the hidden passage, run straight to the control sequence and free the trapped character without detours, combat farming, or menu planning.

levels.1: The A result places a new weapon in shared storage.
levels.2: Save A-rank clear data and open an Item Box on the rewarded campaign.
levels.3: After the result screen displays A, save the clear data. Begin the linked next campaign, reach a shared Item Box, and remove the Infinite Rocket Launcher. Equip and test it on a backup branch without overwriting the clean clear.

levels.1: Campaign completion opens a fixed-room combat course.
levels.2: Save any completed campaign result, then select Battle Game.
levels.3: Finish the HD campaign at any rank, save the completion flag, and return to the title menu. Enter Battle Game, confirm the initial Claire and Chris routes, and preserve this data while unlocking the remaining roster.

levels.1: The bonus course supports a second aiming perspective.
levels.2: Select first-person view and finish one Battle character route.
levels.3: After the campaign unlocks the camera option, start Battle Game in first-person, clear all fixed rooms with any unlocked character, and record the result. Repeat that character once in third-person so both modes are completed.

save_backup.title: Keep the midpoint and clear-data backups
save_backup.why: A failed rank condition may not be visible until the result screen.

areas.name: Battle Game Roster
areas.location_cue: A fixed combat course selected from the cleared-data bonus menu.
areas.note: Unlock and finish all five loadouts in both available camera styles where practical.

levels.1: Each roster member has a separate fixed-course completion.
levels.2: Unlock Claire by available after campaign, then finish Battle Game.
levels.3: Save cleared campaign data, select Claire in Battle Game, and finish the fixed course. Favor her unlimited explosive arrows, keep all four mixed herbs for mistakes, and save menu time by ignoring ordinary pickups.

levels.1: Test every weapon and healing allowance unique to this route.
levels.2: Start with explosive arrows and four mixed herbs.
levels.3: Open Claire's starting inventory, equip every available weapon at least once, and inspect the healing supply. Complete the course without discarding unique equipment; unlimited ammunition here does not transfer into the campaign.

levels.1: Each roster member has a separate fixed-course completion.
levels.2: Unlock Alternate Claire by clear Battle as Claire, then finish Battle Game.
levels.3: First finish Battle Game as standard Claire. Select Alternate Claire, use her launcher and assault rifle, preserve the single mixed herb, and complete all rooms to register the alternate loadout.

levels.1: Test every weapon and healing allowance unique to this route.
levels.2: Start with launcher and assault rifle and one mixed herb.
levels.3: Open Alternate Claire's starting inventory, equip every available weapon at least once, and inspect the healing supply. Complete the course without discarding unique equipment; unlimited ammunition here does not transfer into the campaign.

levels.1: Each roster member has a separate fixed-course completion.
levels.2: Unlock Chris by available after campaign, then finish Battle Game.
levels.3: Save cleared campaign data, select Chris, and complete Battle Game. Use the unlimited Magnum for rapid room clears, retain the shotgun as backup, and finish once to activate Wesker's roster flag.

levels.1: Test every weapon and healing allowance unique to this route.
levels.2: Start with infinite Magnum and shotgun and two mixed herbs.
levels.3: Open Chris's starting inventory, equip every available weapon at least once, and inspect the healing supply. Complete the course without discarding unique equipment; unlimited ammunition here does not transfer into the campaign.

levels.1: Each roster member has a separate fixed-course completion.
levels.2: Unlock Steve by obtain Luger Replica, then finish Battle Game.
levels.3: Take the Gold Luger Replica from the colored-drawer puzzle in the main campaign and save afterward. Select Steve in Battle Game, use the submachine guns for speed, and finish the complete room sequence.

levels.1: Test every weapon and healing allowance unique to this route.
levels.2: Start with Lugers and submachine guns and two mixed herbs.
levels.3: Open Steve's starting inventory, equip every available weapon at least once, and inspect the healing supply. Complete the course without discarding unique equipment; unlimited ammunition here does not transfer into the campaign.

levels.1: Each roster member has a separate fixed-course completion.
levels.2: Unlock Wesker by clear Battle as Chris, then finish Battle Game.
levels.3: Clear Battle Game once as Chris to unlock Wesker. With only a knife at the start, use downward leg cuts to create space, enter the optional Game Room, secure its Magnum result, and reserve all six rounds for the last encounter.

levels.1: Test every weapon and healing allowance unique to this route.
levels.2: Start with knife only initially and three mixed herbs.
levels.3: Open Wesker's starting inventory, equip every available weapon at least once, and inspect the healing supply. Complete the course without discarding unique equipment; unlimited ammunition here does not transfer into the campaign.

save_backup.title: Back up completed Battle data
save_backup.why: Character unlocks and results accumulate on the same save.

areas.name: Battle A Ranks and Random Rewards
areas.location_cue: Nineteen combat stages, an optional side Game Room, and character-specific final rooms.
areas.note: Earn all five A ranks, obtain the Linear Launcher, and document every slot-machine outcome.

levels.1: The top grade uses a character-specific time limit.
levels.2: Finish Claire's route in 6:09.99 or less.
levels.3: Use explosive arrows, memorize the direct door line through all fixed rooms, and ignore healing pickups unless survival requires one. Finish at 6:09.99 or faster; confirm A on the result screen before saving the character result.

levels.1: The top grade uses a character-specific time limit.
levels.2: Finish Alternate Claire's route in 7:59.99 or less.
levels.3: Use acid or flame launcher rounds, memorize the direct door line through all fixed rooms, and ignore healing pickups unless survival requires one. Finish at 7:59.99 or faster; confirm A on the result screen before saving the character result.

levels.1: The top grade uses a character-specific time limit.
levels.2: Finish Chris's route in 6:29.99 or less.
levels.3: Use unlimited Magnum, memorize the direct door line through all fixed rooms, and ignore healing pickups unless survival requires one. Finish at 6:29.99 or faster; confirm A on the result screen before saving the character result.

levels.1: The top grade uses a character-specific time limit.
levels.2: Finish Steve's route in 9:59.99 or less.
levels.3: Use submachine guns, memorize the direct door line through all fixed rooms, and ignore healing pickups unless survival requires one. Finish at 9:59.99 or faster; confirm A on the result screen before saving the character result.

levels.1: The top grade uses a character-specific time limit.
levels.2: Finish Wesker's route in 59:59.99 or less.
levels.3: Select third-person view for spatial awareness, cut downward at legs, and avoid unnecessary kills where the exit unlock permits movement. Detour to the slot machine until it yields the six-round Magnum, then reserve every shot for the last encounter.

items.label: A Rank with All Five Characters

levels.1: The final bonus weapon requires every individual top result.
levels.2: Earn A as Claire, Alternate Claire, Chris, Steve, and Wesker.
levels.3: Complete each character at or below their own A threshold and verify all five result records remain on the same completion data. Do not use the Linear Launcher during these qualifying runs because it suppresses normal grading.

levels.1: Five top results add a universal Battle-only weapon.
levels.2: After all five A ranks, start a new Battle route and inspect its inventory.
levels.3: Once every roster member has A, save the Battle data and begin any character route. Equip the Linear Launcher from the starting inventory and fire it; its unlimited ammunition remains inside Battle Game and prevents that run from receiving a grade.

levels.1: The combat course is fixed enough to memorize door lines.
levels.2: Clear all nineteen stages and the character-specific final room.
levels.3: Run the route repeatedly until every spawn, exit, and optional Game Room turn is familiar. Use quick knockdowns instead of full eliminations where doors permit, and enter the final room with the route's best weapon equipped.

levels.1: A side room offers one random item per attempt.
levels.2: Before the later rooms, take the side door and operate the lit machine.
levels.3: At the branch immediately before the Game Room, use the right-hand side door and inspect the illuminated slot machine. Record its single result, then either continue or restart; D.I.J.'s Diary and Wesker's Magnum depend on this random draw.

levels.1: The machine splits between ammunition, healing, and a document.
levels.2: Roll for special arrows, a First Aid Spray, or D.I.J.'s Diary.
levels.3: With Claire, each new course attempt gives a 20% special-ammunition result, 40% First Aid Spray, or 40% D.I.J.'s Diary. Restart until both non-healing outcomes have been observed across separate attempts.

levels.1: Her rare roll changes the launcher's available ammunition.
levels.2: Roll for gas rounds, a First Aid Spray, or D.I.J.'s Diary.
levels.3: With Alternate Claire, document the 20% unlimited B.O.W. Gas result, the 40% First Aid Spray result, and the 40% diary result across repeat attempts. Fire one gas round when that prize appears.

levels.1: His rare roll supplies another automatic weapon family.
levels.2: Roll for M-100P, a First Aid Spray, or D.I.J.'s Diary.
levels.3: With Chris, repeat the course until the slot machine has produced the 20% unlimited M-100P result and the 40% diary result. The remaining 40% outcome is a First Aid Spray; record it on another attempt if needed.

levels.1: His optional machine uses the same three-way distribution.
levels.2: Roll for M-100P, a First Aid Spray, or D.I.J.'s Diary.
levels.3: With Steve, document the 20% unlimited M-100P prize, the 40% First Aid Spray, and the 40% diary across repeat starts. The extra pistols are optional because his opening submachine guns already have unlimited ammunition.

levels.1: One random prize is practically required for the last room.
levels.2: Restart until the slot machine awards the six-round Magnum.
levels.3: With Wesker, the machine yields the six-shot Magnum on 80% of attempts and D.I.J.'s Diary on 20%. Restart immediately after a diary roll when pursuing the clear, then preserve all six Magnum rounds for the final encounter.

save_backup.title: Save after every A result
save_backup.why: Losing one character record blocks the five-rank reward.

areas.name: Easter Eggs and Mechanical Secrets
areas.location_cue: Battle mirrors, statues, machines, frozen corridors, hidden models, and a starting-file glitch.
areas.note: Use a non-ranking Battle attempt and an expendable campaign backup for these interactions.

levels.1: Returning through a cleared frozen corridor triggers a unique idle response.
levels.2: In Claire's Battle route, clear the frozen hallway and run back toward its entrance.
levels.3: Defeat the hallway enemies, continue far enough for the room state to settle, then reverse course toward the starting door. Pause without aiming and watch the cold reaction complete before continuing.

levels.1: A cleared locker room changes one reflective surface.
levels.2: In Chris's Battle route, defeat both Hunters, then examine the mirror.
levels.3: Clear both Hunters from the locker room, return to the mirror after combat music stops, and use the examine prompt. Remain still until the hair-adjustment animation finishes.

levels.1: The familiar statue has a harmless bonus interaction in Battle Game.
levels.2: Inspect the tiger statue in Chris's sterile-room route.
levels.3: During Chris's Battle course, clear the sterile room enough to interact safely, stand directly before the tiger statue, and examine it. Let the full hand-motion animation play before using the next door.

levels.1: One drink machine reacts only to this Battle character.
levels.2: Inspect the soda machine near Steve's casino route.
levels.3: During Steve's Battle course, approach the soda machine near the casino or locker area and use the examine prompt. Wait for the kick animation to finish, then resume the timed route on a non-ranking attempt.

levels.1: A cleared examination room enables a character-specific reaction.
levels.2: After clearing Wesker's morgue, examine the body on its table.
levels.3: Defeat the room's enemies, wait until combat ends, and examine the body in the morgue while controlling Wesker. Watch the glasses-and-recoil animation completely before leaving.

levels.1: The alternate camera reveals a motionless figure behind freight.
levels.2: In first-person Battle view, look behind the crates in room seven.
levels.3: Start Battle Game in first-person, reach the seventh room, and scan behind the stacked crates before exiting. Observe the hidden model without assigning it story meaning or trying to interact; it is only a visual secret.

levels.1: An unread starting manual can produce a repeatable healing item.
levels.2: Back up, arrange Playing Manual, gun, then healing item in inventory.
levels.3: On an expendable save, keep the manual unread, order the inventory as Playing Manual, any gun, then the chosen healing item, equip the gun, and read the manual from Files. Exit, attempt one shot, then use the now-equipped healing item; never combine a glitched herb.

levels.1: The twenty-fourth document is randomized inside the bonus course.
levels.2: Use Battle Game's optional slot machine until the diary appears.
levels.3: Enter the side Game Room on repeated Battle attempts and operate the slot machine once per run. When D.I.J.'s Diary appears, open every page before leaving; any roster member can roll it, though Wesker's diary chance is lower.

save_backup.title: Back up before the healing glitch
save_backup.why: It consumes the unread manual state and can confuse ordinary inventory records.
